title: King Asa Calls on God
traveler_why: Willow is the Traveler with the warm, reaching heart, and tonight King Asa reaches up to God when the army is too big: Willow whispers a prayer on a too-big first day at a new school and finds a friend.
traveler_about: Willow fits tonight because Willow knows that a warm heart is not afraid to reach out for help, and tonight King Asa reaches up to God. In Willow’s world today: it is Willow’s first day at a brand-new school. The hallways are long, the building is huge, and there are so many kids she does not know. Willow feels very small by the cubbies. So she squeezes her hands together and whispers, “Please help me, God.” A minute later a girl with a warm smile asks Willow to sit by her. Just like King Asa facing the giant army, Willow learned that no problem is too big for God.
